profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, UI/UX at Pulsis
profile.summary: I'm currently a Software Engineer at Microsoft. I am a passionate strategic thinker who loves to solve problems for users.

positions.title: Global Technology Analyst Program-Software Engineer I
positions.description: Collaborated with developers to analyze a wireframe issue to ensure the page is accessible for the user. Adhere to team delivery/release process and cadence pertaining to code and deployments.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Trained and assisted new users on additive rapid prototyping technologies. Provided audio/video equipment support for University faculty and staff members. Maintained IT infrastructure, including deployment of new and refurbished desktop and laptop systems.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I was able to assist graduate students with their proposal and projects. I wrote literature reviews based off of the graduate students research. I was able to start my own project where I was able to write code in order to make a robot help students learn.

positions.title: University of South Carolina IT Services
positions.description: I was able to train and assist new users on additive rapid prototyping technologies. Provided an audio/video equipment support for university faculty and staff members. Maintained IT infrastructure, including deployment, of new and refurbished desktop and laptop systems.

positions.title: Global Technology Analyst Intern
positions.description: Facilitated daily meetings with business owners and developers to be able to develop and manage the service of the application. Was able to create documentation including data mapping and outlined the resources need to articulate the value of the application to support customer success. Managed and developed a script for validating existing/new products prior to production deployments and the technical team to ensure the customer would have the best experience.
